verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The pack only shows that agents are defined as a small YAML config and that roles control who can configure them. Nothing documents config versioning, change review, or rollback. Keeping the YAML in your own source control would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
